title: Viessmann Vitogate 300 BN/MB vitogate.cgi form-0-2 Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Viessmann Vitogate 300 BN/MB devices. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of JSON payload data provided to the vitogate.cgi endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device.
